items.question: What visual attributes characterize the dark central deity in perpetual embrace?
premises: The deity is described as shining and dark in color.
The deity occupies a position in the middle.
Two women perpetually embrace the deity.
items.inference: The meditative form is a radiant, dark central figure constantly embraced by two women.
uncertainties: The term kṛṣṇaṃ may denote dark color or refer to the deity Kṛṣṇa.
items.plain_english: Visualize the deity as always shining, dark, standing in the middle, and embraced by two women.
